coordinates.policy: Site display is Three.js Y-up. Rhino Map-Z-to-glTF-Y is already in the file; do not swap axes again. Plan polygons store (x,z) in site feet. Lattice proto forms stay 20×20×20 ft and are not stretched to the property.

statements: Derive walls from real source edges and recomputed receiver intervals.
Preserve differences between direct contacts, recessed connections and intentional openings.
Print variants derive stepped contour floors, roof planks, partial returns and upper columns.
Keep mesh integrity separate from circulation and structural validation.

parameters.receiverContract: Approved direct walls end at receiver bottoms; print walls use their recorded top-edge rules.

request.sourceName: Linear Edge Gallery · 55° compact upper form

savedRuleARequest.sourceName: Linear Edge Gallery · 55° compact upper form

validationEnvelope.reason: Plan envelope expanded to contain full selected polygon; height, source poses and glyphs unchanged. Exact polygon containment is independently enforced.

provenance.transform: board X/Y/Z → site X/Z/Y; rigid heading + translation + datum; reverse winding

measurements.buildingFootprintDefinition: Union of final Rule B architectural solid plan projections, including walls, floor plates, roof decks, enclosures and projections; excludes Rule A letters. Not a local zoning certification.
measurements.terraceDefinition: Lower roof/deck footprint minus all upper architectural projections; potential exposed terrace, not certified usable circulation area.
measurements.protectedVoidDefinition: Union of source holes, exclusions, reserves and corridor masks within the selected polygon. Native openings are not automatically classified as protected voids.
measurements.nativeProtectedVoidSemanticRecords: No separate protected-void semantic records are emitted by this print variant.
measurements.nativeFieldConstraint: Only the native plan validation envelope was expanded to contain the full source polygon. No 25% cap is applied. Source letters, height, native rules and architectural geometry are unchanged; exact site containment is enforced after formation.

limitations: Authentic saved print-contour variant only. No typology blending.
Native architectural assertions and site containment pass; accessibility, structural, egress and code compliance are not established.
